title: cimcdm: Cloud-Integration Multicriteria Decision Model - reproducibility archive
description:
Reference implementation and reproducibility archive for the article Multicriteria Model for Integrating Distributed Systems into Cloud Services.

The software implements a time-aware, three-objective binary portfolio model in which benefit accumulation, organizational adaptation and residual risk are explicit functions of time. It reproduces every headline result of the article: exact enumeration of all 262,144 portfolios of the 18-system synthetic benchmark (83,657 feasible, 446 Pareto-optimal, exact hypervolume 0.421543), 30 matched replications of NSGA-II and a reference-direction NSGA-III variant, a 231-weight weighted-sum baseline, paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction, and a 25-cell sensitivity analysis of the adaptation and economic-benefit accumulation rates.

The archive ships a self-verifying validation module that re-derives the published numbers and reports pass or fail for each claim, a command-line interface, and a Google Colab notebook that runs the whole study end to end in the browser without local installation.
